title: GOD IS FIGHTING FOR ME THIS MORNING
text: Holy Spirit, you are welcome here. You are welcome here. Take over this altar. Take over this atmosphere. We are not here to perform religion. We are here to encounter the living God. I want to begin reading to you from the book of Exodus chapter 14 verse 14. And the Bible says, "Write it down. Put it in your spirit. The Lord shall fight for you and you shall hold your peace. The Lord shall fight for you. You shall hold your peace." And then I want to go to 2 Chronicles chapter 20 verse 15. >> [music] >> The spirit of the Lord came upon Jahaziel and he said, "Thus saith the Lord unto you. Be not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude for the battle is not yours but God's. The battle is not yours but God's." I want to preach to you this morning under the anointing of the Holy Spirit on the subject, "God is fighting for me." Not God will fight for me past tense, present tense, future tense simultaneously. God is fighting right now while you are dealing with confusion, while you are dealing with pressure, while the enemy has mounted an assault against your life, your family, your finances, your destiny, God is already in the battlefield. He didn't wait for you to ask him. He didn't wait for the situation to get worse. He entered the battlefield before you even knew there was a war. Somebody shout, "God is fighting for me." Now listen, Israel is at the Red Sea. Their backs are to the water. The enemy is behind them. Pharaoh's armies, chariots, horses, weapons, trained soldiers are closing in on them. [clears throat] And humanly speaking, there is no escape. There is absolutely no way out. And Moses turns to the people and says something that would sound like the most ridiculous statement in that moment, "Stand still and see the salvation of the Lord. Don't run. Don't fight. Stand still." Now, what Moses understood that the people were not yet able to comprehend is that there are battles that do not require your energy. There are battles that do not require your wisdom, your network, your connection, your intelligence. There are battles where God shows up and says, "Move out of the way. I've got this one." Every person in this place, every soul watching right now, every spirit that is connected to this altar, I want you to hear me by the spirit of God. The battle you are fighting right now is one of those battles. This is not a battle that human wisdom will resolve. This is not a battle that political connection will settle. This is a battle that God has already entered on your behalf. And the word of God is telling you to stand still. But, what does standing still mean? Does it mean passivity? Does it mean you go back to sleep and fold your arms? No. Standing still in the context of spiritual warfare means you take your position in prayer. You take your position in the word. You take your position in worship, and you release God to fight for you without the interference of your doubt, your fear, your panic, and your own carnal strategies. Because sometimes, hear me, sometimes when God is fighting for you, your panic is the thing that gets in his way. Your fear is the thing that clouds your ability to see what God is already doing. Your anxiety is the thing that makes you take decisions that are out of alignment with God's timing and God's strategy. I decree over somebody's life right now. The panic is over. The confusion is over. You will begin to see with clarity what God is doing in your situation. Now, turn with me to the book of Psalms chapter 46, verses 1 through 3. God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble. Therefore, will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea, though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. A very present help, not a distant help, not a future help, present help. God is present in your trouble. God is present in your affliction. God is not watching from a distance wondering when to intervene. He's already there. He was there before the trouble started. He knew this was coming. He prepared a way of escape before you even entered the situation. And the psalmist says, "Therefore we will not fear." Not because the problem disappeared, the waters are still roaring, the mountains are still shaking, the earth is still trembling, but because God is present, fear has no basis. Fear has no ground to stand on. Fear is a liar in the [music] presence of God. Somebody shout, "God is in this place." I want to talk to you for a moment about the nature of divine battles because not every battle God fights for you looks the same. Sometimes God fights for you through provision. He supplies what you need before you know you need it. Sometimes God fights for you through protection. You don't even know what was coming against you because God already deflected it in the night. Sometimes God fights for you through confusion in the enemy's camp. He sends a spirit of confusion among those who have gathered against you and they begin to destroy each other. Go to 2 Chronicles 20 again, the story of Jehoshaphat. Three nations have gathered against Judah. They are outnumbered, but they have no military strategy that can win this war. And Jehoshaphat, I love what he does. He doesn't call a military meeting. He calls a prayer meeting. He says, "We do not know what to do, but our eyes are upon you. We do not know what to do, but our eyes are upon you." There's something powerful in that statement. It is not a statement of defeat. It is a statement of strategy. It is a declaration that says, "Lord, I have reached the end of my own capacity and I'm handing the controls to you. I am getting out of the driver's seat. I am not going to trust in my own understanding. Proverbs 3:5 and 6 says, "Trust in the Lord with all thine heart and lean not onto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him and he shall direct thy paths." He shall direct thy paths. Not he might, not he will try. He shall direct your paths. And God's response to Jehoshaphat is astonishing. He says, "You don't even need to fight this battle. Set yourselves. Stand still. See the salvation of the Lord." And he sends the singers in front of the army. The worshipers go ahead and as they begin to praise God, the Bible says God sent ambushments against the enemy. The enemy began to destroy one another. And by the time Judah got to the battlefield, there were only dead bodies everywhere. Judah didn't lift a sword. Judah didn't lose a single soldier. God fought the battle himself. I am prophesying to somebody right now you are about to arrive at a battlefield where the enemy is already dead. You are about to step into a situation and discover that while you were worshipping, while you were praying, while you were trusting God, he already fought the battle on your behalf. You are going to arrive at victory without knowing how the war was won. Now, let me shift into something that I need to address because there are people in this service who are wondering, "But why is God fighting for me? What have I done to deserve this?" And I want to settle this in your spirit right now. God doesn't fight for you because you are perfect. God doesn't fight for you because you have never made mistakes. God fights for you because of covenant. God fights for you because of who he is, not because of who you are. Romans 8:31 says, "What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us? If God be for us, if that conditional is not based on your perfection, is based on your position in Christ. Because when you gave your life to Jesus, you were positioned inside the covenant of God. And inside that covenant, God is obligated not by weakness, but by faithfulness to show up on your behalf. Go to Isaiah 54:17. No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper, and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment, thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord, and their righteousness is of me, saith the Lord. This is your heritage, not a hope, not a wish. This is what belongs to you as a servant of the Lord. No weapon, not some weapons, not most weapons, no weapon that is formed against you shall prosper. I need you to understand the power of that word formed. It doesn't say no weapon that is launched shall prosper. It says no weapon that is formed. In other words, even in the formation stage, even when the enemy is still planning, still strategizing, still designing the weapon against your life, God has already declared it will not prosper. The plan will be disrupted, the strategy will collapse, the conspiracy will be exposed. Somebody shout no weapon. Now, I want to begin to move us into prayer, but before I let me say one more thing. Because there's a truth about divine battles that we must not miss. When God fights for you, he doesn't just fight to rescue you, he fights to establish you. He doesn't just fight to bring you out of the problem, he fights to bring you into your purpose. He doesn't just fight to give you temporary relief, he fights to give you permanent victory. Look at what happened after the Red Sea crossed. Pharaoh and all his armies, horses, chariots, soldiers drowned in the Red Sea, and the Bible records that there was not one of them left. Not one. God didn't do a partial job. God didn't let a few escape to come back later. He completely, thoroughly, comprehensively destroyed the enemy, and Israel walked out on dry ground. That is the nature of God's fighting. When he moves on your behalf, he moves with totality. He moves with finality. He moves to ensure that what comes against you never rises against you again. I decree into your life right now. What God is fighting for you this morning will not be a temporary victory. It will be a permanent settlement. The enemy that has been troubling your life will not have the capacity to trouble you again after this encounter. Now, let's pray. Let's go into prayer. Everybody stand to your feet. Stand to your feet and lift your hands before God. This is not the time to sit. This is the time to stand. This is the time to engage. Holy Spirit, breathe on this altar right now. Let the fire of God descend. Let the glory of God fill this place. We ask for an open heaven over every life connected to this service. Every ear that is hearing this word, Lord, let it penetrate past the skull, past the intellect, past the mind, and go deep into the spirit man. Let this word become a seed of fire in every life today. Now, begin to pray in tongues. Begin to pray in the spirit. Release your prayer language. Don't be ashamed. Don't be self-conscious. The Holy Spirit is here, and he's interceding through you with groanings that cannot be uttered. Pray. Pray. Pray. Father, I come before your throne of grace right now on behalf of every life connected to this service. I approach the throne boldly, not because of my own righteousness, but because of the blood of Jesus Christ. The blood that was shed on Calvary, that blood is speaking right now and it is speaking better things than the blood of Abel. I declare the blood of Jesus is working on your behalf right now. Every accusation the enemy has raised before the throne of God against your life is silenced by the blood of Jesus. Every legal right the enemy has claimed over your destiny is revoked right now by the power of the blood. >> [music] >> The blood of Jesus speaks. The blood of Jesus speaks. Every dark record, every evil covenant, every satanic claim, the blood of Jesus speaks against it right now. Father, your word says that you are a man of war. Exodus 15:3, The Lord is a man of war, the Lord is his name. So, I call upon you now as the warrior God, the God who fights, the God who has never lost a battle, the God before whom no enemy can stand. Rise up in the affairs of every life here today. Rise up in divine battle array. I decree every principality that has been assigned against your life, I command them. Your assignment is revoked in the name of Jesus. Every power of darkness that has been stationed at the gate of your destiny, I pull you down right now in the name of Jesus. Every demonic stronghold that has been erected in your bloodline, in your family, in your household, I command you. COME DOWN. COME DOWN. COME DOWN IN THE name of Jesus. Father, the Bible says in Psalm 35:1, Plead my cause, O Lord, with them that strive with me. Fight against them that fight against me. Lord, plead their cause. Plead the cause of every life connected to this altar. Every person who has been fighting alone, who has been struggling in silence, who has been carrying burdens that are too heavy, Lord, plead their cause. Enter the battle on their behalf. Let every force that has been warring against them feel the weight of your divine intervention. I decree God is pleading your cause right now. God is presenting your case before the courts of heaven and the verdict has already been declared. You win. You are not condemned. You are not abandoned. You are not forgotten. God has presented your case and the verdict is in your favor. Now, pray with me. Put your hand on your chest and pray these words. Lord, every door that the enemy has shut in my life, open them right now. Every opportunity that has been blocked by satanic interference, release it right now. Every blessing [clears throat] that has been delayed, diverted, and redirected, I call them back right now in the name of Jesus. Let the doors open. Let the gates lift up. Let the ancient doors of my destiny swing open in the name of Jesus. SHOUT IT. SHOUT IT WITH FIRE. OPEN. OPEN. OPEN. I decree open doors over your life. I decree open doors over your ministry. I decree open doors over your business. I decree open doors over your family. Every gate that has been locked against you, the King of Glory is entering that gate right now and he's holding the door open for you to walk through. Psalm 24 verses 7 and 8. Lift up your heads, oh ye gates, and be ye lifted up, ye everlasting doors, and the King of Glory shall come in. Who is this King of Glory? The Lord strong and mighty, the Lord mighty in battle. The Lord mighty in battle is walking through the gates of your destiny today and he's clearing every obstruction, every obstacle, every satanic barricade that has been standing between you and your ordained portion. Now, I want to pray specifically for family deliverance. I want to pray for everyone whose family has been under attack, everyone whose home has become a battlefield, everyone whose marriage is under siege, everyone whose children are being targeted by the enemy. Lift your hands. This prayer is for you. Father, in the name of Jesus, I cover every family represented in this service under the blood of Jesus Christ. I put a blood covering over every marriage. I put a blood covering over every home. I put a blood covering over every child. I declare the angel of death will not enter your home. The spirit of division will not find a dwelling place in your marriage. The spirit of rebellion will not rule over your children. I command every satanic agent that has been sent into homes as a spouse, as a friend, as a colleague, the fire of God expose you right now. The fire of God drive you out right now. Your assignment is destroyed in the name of Jesus. For every marriage that is under pressure right now, I decree restoration in the name of Jesus. I decree that the love that God deposited in that union is being rekindled right now. I decree that the enemy's plan to destroy what God has joined together will not stand. What God has joined together, let no man, let no demon, let no witch, let no principality put asunder. I speak to prodigal sons and prodigal daughters right now. There are parents in this service who are crying in the night over children who have gone astray, children who are in the world, children who have turned their backs on God and on family. I speak to those children by the spirit of the Lord. The spirit of God is pursuing you right now. The grace of God is running after you right now. Like the father of the prodigal son who saw him while he was yet a great way off and ran to meet him, Your father in heaven is running toward you. Come home. Come home. And to those parents, I decree your children shall be saved. Acts 16:31 says, "Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and thou shalt be saved and thy house." Your household is coming into salvation. Your household is coming into alignment with the kingdom of God. Not one shall be lost. Now, I want to pray for financial breakthrough. I want to pray for everyone who is under financial pressure. Everyone who has been experiencing lack, poverty, delay, and setback in the area of finances. Don't be ashamed. Lift your hands. This prayer is about to change your story. Father, your word says in Philippians 4:19, "But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus." All your need, not some of your need. All your need according to his riches, not according to the economy of the nation, not according to the stock market, not according to the opinion of your employer, according to his riches in glory. I speak to the financial gates over every life connected to this altar. I command the gates of supernatural supply to open right now in the name of Jesus. I command the wells of divine provision to be uncorked right now. Every satanic padlock on your finances, I destroy it right now with the blood of Jesus. The Bible says in Deuteronomy 28:12, "The Lord shall open unto thee his good treasure in the heaven to give the rain of thy land in his season and to bless all the work of thine hands." His good treasure. God has a treasure house in heaven marked with your name, and I decree it is being opened right now. It is being released right now. What belongs to you is coming to you. I decree you will not borrow again, you will not lack again, you will not be at the bottom, you will be at the top. You will lend to nations, you will be a financier of the kingdom. You will be a lender and not a borrower. God's word declares it and I'm decreeing it over your life today. I speak to every evil covenant of poverty, every generational curse of lack that has been running in your bloodline, I cut it right now with the sword of the spirit. The curse is broken. The covenant is destroyed. Poverty will not follow you into the next chapter of your life. I speak to everyone who has been cheated, defrauded, stolen from someone, took something from you. A business partner betrayed you, an employer defrauded you, someone took your idea and ran with it. I speak to what belongs to you, come back. Come back in the name of Jesus. Seven times over, what was taken from you shall return. The thief shall restore sevenfold. Father, supernaturally connect your people to divine helpers, to divine financiers, to men and women of means who will speak your name in rooms you've never entered. Father, go ahead of them into boardrooms and marketplace gatherings and let their names be spoken in favor. Let doors open supernaturally, let contracts be signed, let businesses thrive, let what they've planted in faith begin to yield supernatural harvest. I speak to the seed that has been in the ground for too long. Spring up right now. Spring up in the name of Jesus. The season of waiting is over, the season of harvest has arrived. What was delayed is now being accelerated. Now, let's pray for healing, for health and healing, for everybody under attack, for every diagnosis that has brought fear, every doctor's report that has brought grief and confusion. Lift your hands. Put your hand on wherever there is pain, wherever there is sickness, wherever there's affliction right now. Father, by the stripes of Jesus Christ, by the wounds that were inflicted on his body on Calvary, I decree healing. 1 Peter 2:24 says, "Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree, that we being dead to sins should live on to righteousness." By whose stripes you were healed. Were healed. Past tense. Your healing happened on the cross 2,000 years ago. I am not asking God to heal you. I am commanding the healing that already belongs to you to manifest in your body right now. I command cancer. You are an illegal occupant. In the name of Jesus, pack out of that body. You have no legal right to that body. It is the temple of the Holy Spirit. Leave right now in the name of Jesus. I command tumors dissolve. In the name of Jesus, dissolve. Every growth, every mass, every abnormal tissue, receive the fire of the Holy Spirit right now and dissolve. I command diabetes. Your assignment is terminated. The blood sugar of every diabetic connected to this altar is normalizing right now in the name of Jesus. I speak to hearts be healed. Every heart condition, every blocked artery, every abnormal rhythm receive divine touch right now. The same God who created the heart is repairing it right now. I speak to blood disorders, to sickle cell, to leukemia, to anemia. The blood of Jesus is flowing through your veins right now and bringing healing to every blood cell in your body. I speak to every barren womb, be opened. Be opened in the name of Jesus. The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, the God of Jacob, the God who opened the womb of Sarah when she was past age. The God who opened the womb of Hannah after years of reproach, he's opening your womb right now. You will conceive, you will carry to term, you will give birth to your miracle. I speak to every spine, every joint, every bone be restored. Whatever has been broken be healed. Whatever has been out of alignment come into alignment now. I speak to someone's eyesight is returning. Something has been clouding your vision, but God is restoring sight right now. The scales are falling off. I speak to someone's ears. Hearing is returning. What has been blocked is being cleared right now by the power of the Holy Spirit. Father, let your resurrection power flow through everybody. The same power that raised Jesus from the dead, Romans 8:11 is dwelling in the mortal bodies of your people and it is quickening, it is healing, it is restoring right now. I want to move into a place of spiritual warfare now. I want to deal with the demonic. I want to deal with curses, covenants, evil altars, and witchcraft operations against your life. This is not the moment to be timid. This is the moment to be bold. I decree right now every evil altar that has been erected against your life, I pull it down in the name of Jesus. Judges 6:25, God told Gideon, "Throw down the altar of Baal." I am throwing down every altar that has been built against you. Every witchcraft altar, every ancestral altar, every occult altar, every satanic shrine be pulled down right now in THE FIRE OF GOD. Every covenant of darkness that was made on your behalf with or without your knowledge, before your birth or after, I nullify it right now. I nullify it by the blood of Jesus and the name of Jesus Christ. You are free from the terms and conditions of every dark covenant. The blood of Jesus has redeemed you from the curse of the law. Galatians 3:13. Christ has redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us. For it is written, cursed is everyone that hangeth on a tree. He became the curse so you could be free from the curse. He took it so you could walk in blessing. I decree every generational curse is broken right now. Every family pattern of premature death, every cycle of failure, every bloodline agreement with poverty, with sickness, with barrenness, with madness, with tragedy, it is broken right now in the name of Jesus. It stops at your generation. You are the turning point. I speak to curses sent through words. Someone spoke against you. Someone pronounced something over your life. A parent, an elder, an enemy, they spoke words over you. Words of death. Words of limitation. Words of failure. I command those words to fall to the ground now. I break the power of those words right now. The word of God says death and life are in the power of the tongue, but I reverse every word of death that has been spoken over your life. I cancel it. I nullify it. I replace it with the word of the living God. You are blessed. You are fruitful. You are above and not beneath. You are the head and not the tail. You will fulfill your days. You will complete your assignment. You will die on your feet and not on your bed. Full of years and full of purpose. I deal with witchcraft operations right now. There are people in this service whose progress has been arrested by witchcraft. You have had dreams where you are running and you cannot move. Dreams where you are back in primary school. Dreams where you are naked in public. Dreams where your teeth are falling out. Dreams where someone is chasing you. Dreams where you are in your old family compound eating food. I serve notice on every witchcraft operation. Your power over this life is destroyed right now. Every arrow of witchcraft that has been fired into destiny, I pull it out right now in the name of Jesus. Every prayer point that has been prayed against your life in the night, I reverse it right now. Let the arrow return to sender in the name of Jesus. Every witchcraft bird that has been flying over your destiny, I shoot you down right now with the arrows of God. Psalm 7:13, "He had also prepared for him the instruments of death. He ordained his arrows against the persecutors." The arrows of God are going against your persecutors right now. Every coven that has been meeting over your name, every gathering of darkness that has been deliberating on your life, I scatter that gathering right now. Let confusion enter that camp. Let them turn against one another. Let the conspiracy be exposed. Let the secret agenda be revealed. I speak to everyone who has a household enemy. There is someone in your family, someone who is close to you, who eats at your table, who calls you by name, who is working against you in the spiritual realm. The spirit of God is exposing that person. Their cover is blown. Their assignment is terminated. But, I also decree mercy. Father, save them. If it is possible, bring them to repentance. But, if they will not repent, let your judgment fall on every hand that is raised against the destiny of your people. Now, I want to pray about time and virtual restoration because the enemy has been stealing time. He has been stealing years. He has been stealing seasons. And people in this room feel like they are behind. They feel like the clock has run against them. They feel like they've missed their moment. I speak to the spirit of time manipulation. Your assignment is terminated. Joel 2:25, "And I will restore to you the years that the locusts have eaten, the cankerworm and the caterpillar and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you. I restore" Restoration is happening right now. God is not limited by your age. God is not limited by your delay. He compressed Joseph's journey from the pit to the palace in a single day. He can compress your journey from where you are to where you are destined to be in a supernatural moment. I decree supernatural acceleration. What should have taken 10 years will happen in one. What should have taken five years will happen in six months. God is accelerating your calendar. God is compressing your timeline. The years the enemy stole are being returned with interest. I speak to virtue that has been stolen. There are people who used to be sharp, used to be brilliant, used to be creative, used to be full of energy and fire and something happened and it seems like that fire went out. That gift went dormant. That light got dim. I command virtue to be restored right now in the name of Jesus. Everything that was taken from you, your confidence, your creativity, your intelligence, your spiritual fire, your passion for God, your dreams, your vision come back right now in the name of Jesus. I speak to your brain, be sharpened right now. I speak to your creative mind, be activated right now. I speak to your gift, arise right now. You've been dormant long enough. You've been suppressed long enough. Your time is now. [music] I want to decree angelic intervention right now because God fights for you, not just personally, he sends angelic armies. Psalm 34:7 says, "The angel of the Lord encamped round about them that fear him and delivereth them." The angel of the Lord is camping around your life right now. I release angelic assistance over your life. Angels of warfare go ahead of them. Angels of provision be activated on their behalf. Angels of wisdom minister to them. Angels of protection surround their homes, their vehicles, their places of work, their families. Hebrews 1:14 says, "Angels are ministering spirits sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation." They are sent for you. They are on assignment for you. I activate that angelic assignment right now. Every angel that has been assigned to your life, arise and fulfill your assignment in the name of Jesus. I decree supernatural protection over every vehicle, every car, every motorcycle, every bus, every journey. The angel of the Lord goes before them on every road. Accidents will not find them. Robbers will not target them. Evil will not befall them. Psalm 91:11-12, "For he shall give his angels charge over thee to keep thee in all thy ways. They shall bear thee up in their hands lest thou dash thy foot against a stone." The angels have charge over you in all your ways, not some of your ways, all your ways. Every road you walk is under angelic supervision. Every step you take is under divine protection. I now want to pray for destiny, for purpose, for the fulfillment of assignment, because one of the greatest battles the enemy fights is the battle against your destiny. If he can prevent you from discovering your purpose, if he can delay you from stepping into your assignment, if he can distract you from your ordained path, he doesn't need to destroy you outright. He just needs to keep you from doing the one thing you were born to do. I command every distraction from destiny to be destroyed right now. Every counterfeit assignment, I renounce it. Every wrong relationship that is pulling you away from purpose, I sever that cord right now. Every wrong environment that is trifling your growth, I release you from that environment in the name of Jesus. Father, let every life connected to this altar find their lane. Let them walk in divine purpose. Let them discover the reason for which they were born. Let the gifts within them be stirred up. Let the fire of destiny burn bright in their bellies. Let them wake up every morning knowing why they exist. I speak to someone right now. You have been second-guessing your calling. You have been wondering if what God put in your heart is real. You have been comparing yourself to others and wondering if you qualify. I hear the spirit of God saying to you, "What I put in you is real. What I commissioned you to do is valid. What I spoke over you before you were born has not expired. Your calling is sure. Your election is sure. Rise up. Step forward. Stop hiding. Stop shrinking. Stop playing small. The world is waiting for what God put in you. Jeremiah 1:5, "Before I formed thee in the belly, I knew thee. And before thou came forth out of the womb, I sanctified thee. And I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations." Before you were formed, he knew you. Before you were born, he sanctified you. Before you drew your first breath, he ordained you. Your existence is not accidental. Your life is not a mistake. God designed you with precision and purpose. Rise into it. Walk in it. I decree from this moment you will walk in uncommon purpose. You will do the works that God ordained for you. You will fulfill your days. Your end will be greater than your beginning. Job 42:12, "So the Lord blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning." The latter part of your life will be greater than the first part. What you've seen so far is not the best. The best is still ahead. God is not done with you. God is not through with your story. The greatest chapters are still being written. Now pray with me one more time. Put your hand on your heart and pray these words out loud with fire. Lord, I receive your declaration over my life right now. I receive the verdict of heaven. I am not condemned. I am not abandoned. I am not forgotten. God is fighting for me. God has been fighting for me. God will continue to fight for me. I am protected by the blood of Jesus. I am covered by divine grace. I am surrounded by angelic armies. No weapon against me shall prosper. Every tongue that rises against me in judgment I condemn. This is my heritage as a servant of the Lord. I break every curse over my bloodline right now. I destroy every evil covenant. I pull down every dark altar. I neutralize every witchcraft operation. I cancel every satanic assignment against my life, my family, my finances, my health, my marriage, and my destiny. I declare my doors are open. My gates are lifted. The king of glory has entered my life and he's clearing every obstruction. My blessings are flowing. My harvest is coming. My miracles are manifesting. I declare I will not die before my time. >> [music] >> I will fulfill my days. I will complete my assignment. I will raise my children in righteousness. I will walk in financial abundance. I will be a blessing to my generation. I will fulfill what God ordained for me before the foundation of the world. Father, seal this declaration with your fire. Let it not return void. Let it accomplish the purpose for which it was sent. Isaiah 55:11, "So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth. It shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please. And it shall prosper in the thing where to I sent it." The word shall not return void. It is accomplishing something right now. It is working right now. It is penetrating. It is activating. It is releasing. It is breaking. It is restoring. It is healing. It is delivering. Now, I want to begin to give some words of knowledge because the spirit of God is speaking right now and I cannot ignore what I am hearing. There is someone connected to this service. You've been dealing with a situation in your lungs. A pressure, a heaviness in your chest that doctors have been monitoring. The spirit of God says he's touching that area right now. You are going to feel a release. You are going to go back for a test and the result will be different from what they told you before. Receive your healing right now. There is someone who has been dealing with a legal matter. A case that has been dragging. Something that should have been resolved a long time ago.
